name: simset-glass-004
description: You want to form an amorphous glass by melting a crystal, equilibrating at high temperature, then quenching to low temperature and relaxing. Multiple ensemble sequences can be scientifically reasonable depending on your protocol (e.g., whether you allow box relaxation during quench or try to minimize barostat artifacts). Select all sequences that are reasonable for producing an amorphous glass under typical MD protocols.

examples.input:
units real
atom_style atomic
read_data data.crystal

# options (single token each): nvt-npt, npt-nvt-npt, nve-nvt, nvt-only, npt-npt-npt
# (token means the sequence of ensembles to apply, e.g. "npt-nvt-npt")
